(i) Sanofi may, without consent of RevMed, assign this Agreement or its rights and obligations hereunder in whole or in part to any Affiliate of Sanofi, and RevMed may, with the consent of Sanofi (not to be unreasonably withheld, delayed or conditioned), assign this Agreement or its rights and obligations hereunder in whole or in part to any Affiliate of RevMed; and</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 15.2 meets the preferred position: we may assign to any Sanofi Affiliate without RevMed consent and, without consent, to a successor in a merger, acquisition or asset sale, while RevMed needs our consent (not unreasonably withheld) for affiliate assignments and cannot transfer the RevMed Licensed Patents without our consent. RevMed reciprocal right to assign to a Change of Control successor sits at the fallback, mitigated by the Acquiror Family firewall conditions in p0613-p0614 and by our own termination option on a RevMed Change of Control. No RevMed termination or re-pricing right is triggered by a Sanofi change of control. Noted only: the Section 9.7(a) gross-up on affiliate assignment and cessation of post-termination royalties on a Sanofi Change of Control (p0508) are narrow economic points, not vendor exit rights.
